title: arm_predictions.v1
description: One M arm's cross-section of predicted alpha for ONE trading day. The producer/consumer contract a stacked arm reads through (alpha-engine-config-I9777). The trading day is carried IN the document as well as in the key so a consumer can refuse a payload written for another day rather than train on it. Since alpha-engine-config-I11791 the M producer also writes predicted_alpha_std (and, for a Bayesian fit, its aleatoric and epistemic parts) with the method that produced it; a document written before that carries none of those fields and stays valid.

arm_id.description: The producing arm's full `{slot}:{name}:{spec_hash}` identity. The spec hash is what makes a stacked arm's lineage name the exact base recipe that fed it.

predicted_alpha.description: ticker -> predicted alpha, in the arm's own units (raw). Never standardized here: a transform applied by the producer is a transform no consumer declared.

predicted_alpha_std.description: ticker -> TOTAL predictive std of the label, sqrt(aleatoric + epistemic) when both are known (alpha-engine-config-I11791). The executor's conviction-gate input. Strictly positive: a zero std is a claim of certainty no estimator here can make, so the field is omitted, never zeroed, when no honest figure exists.

predicted_alpha_std_aleatoric.description: ticker -> sqrt(1/alpha_), the std implied by the fit's learned noise precision. Written only under bayesian_posterior_predictive.

predicted_alpha_std_epistemic.description: ticker -> sqrt(x^T Sigma_w x), the estimation-error std from the weight posterior. Written only under bayesian_posterior_predictive; the only vector the executor's GUW Omega may be built from.

predicted_alpha_std_method.description: How predicted_alpha_std was produced. 'omitted' means no honest figure exists for this fit: no std field is present and predicted_alpha_std_note says why.

predicted_alpha_std_note.description: The method's detail (e.g. how many out-of-sample residuals the variance rests on) or, under 'omitted', the reason no std was written.
